SELECT FROM payment_order WHERE order_id=#{value} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_intent_request(id,request_key,order_id,user_id,created_at) VALUES(#{id},#{key},#{orderId},#{userId},UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
mapper.select: SELECT order_id,user_id FROM payment_intent_request WHERE request_key=#{key} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_intent_request SET payment_id=#{paymentId} WHERE request_key=#{key}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payment_channel_receipt WHERE payment_id=#{paymentId} AND receipt_sha256=#{digest}
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_order SET dispatch_state='RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED',version=version+1, updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{paymentId}
mapper.select: SELECT payment_id,state,preorder_req_time,trade_req_date,timeout_express_minutes, identity_hmac_sha256,may_have_sent_at,preorder_response_sha256,parameters_ciphertext, parameters_iv,parameter_valid_until,fenced_at,close_may_have_sent_at, close_response_sha256,terminal_query_sha256,terminal_confirmed_at,terminal_close_capability FROM payment_dispatch WHERE payment_id=#{paymentId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_dispatch SET state='MAY_HAVE_SENT',preorder_req_time=#{requestTime}, trade_req_date=#{tradeDate},timeout_express_minutes=#{timeoutMinutes}, identity_hmac_sha256=#{identityHmac},may_have_sent_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE payment_id=#{paymentId} AND state='PREPARED' AND fenced_at IS NULL
UPDATE payment_dispatch SET preorder_response_sha256=#{sha},version=version+1, updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE payment_id=#{paymentId}
UPDATE payment_dispatch SET state='UNKNOWN',version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE payment_id=#{paymentId} AND state='MAY_HAVE_SENT'
UPDATE payment_dispatch SET fenced_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),version=version+1, updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE payment_id=#{paymentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_channel_receipt(id,payment_id,receipt_sha256,channel_trade_no, channel_status,total_amount,paid_amount,paid_at,received_at,receipt_source,channel_response_sha256) VALUES(#{id},#{paymentId},#{digest},#{tradeNo},'CLOSE',NULL,NULL,NULL, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),'CLOSE',#{responseSha}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payment_channel_receipt WHERE payment_id=#{paymentId} AND (channel_status IN ('SUCCESS','PART_REFUND','REFUND','REVOKED') OR paid_amount>0)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payment_channel_receipt WHERE payment_id=#{paymentId} AND receipt_source='CLOSE' AND channel_status='CLOSE' AND channel_response_sha256=#{sha}
SELECT id FROM payment_order WHERE order_id=#{orderId} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT t.id FROM payment_transaction t LEFT JOIN payment_order p ON p.id=t.payment_id WHERE p.id IS NULL LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM payment_transaction WHERE payment_id=#{paymentId} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT d.payment_id FROM payment_dispatch d LEFT JOIN payment_order p ON p.id=d.payment_id WHERE p.id IS NULL LIMIT 1
